description: Khairpur Sugar Mills Limited is a public limited sugar company incorporated on 23 August 1989, which began business the following month. It operates a cane sugar mill at Naroo Dhoro, Taluka Kot Diji, District Khairpur in Sindh, and the company states that over 800 employees work under its umbrella and that it contributes roughly PKR 750 million a year to the government in sales tax, excise duty, income tax and other levies.
